RAJESH SANTHA Senior Data Engineer · Spark | PySpark | Databricks | Airflow | Azure

+91 70322 16316 | rajesh.santha91@gmail.com | Hyderabad, India | B.Tech – Information Technology – JNTU Hyderabad

C A R E E R S U M M A R Y

Senior Data Engineer with 11+ years of experience building scalable batch and real-time data platforms using Spark (Scala/PySpark),

Azure Databricks, Airflow, Delta Lake, Kafka, and Azure cloud technologies.

Proven expertise in designing reusable ingestion frameworks, optimizing distributed Spark pipelines, and delivering high-performance

cloud-based data solutions across banking, aviation, telecom, retail, and insurance domains.

Azure & Databricks certified professional with a strong foundation in computer science and distributed systems.

T E C H N I C A L S K I L L S

Languages: Scala, Python Big Data & Streaming: Apache Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL, Spark Structured Streaming, Delta Lake, Apache Kafka, Hive, Cloudera CDP Cloud & Platforms: Azure Databricks, ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, Snowflake, SQL Server, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, HBase, HDFS Architecture: Medallion Architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold), Lambda & Kappa patterns Orchestration: Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Control-M, Apache Oozie CI/CD & Version Control: Git, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Bitbucket, Azure Repos, Maven, SBT Tools: IntelliJ IDEA, Eclipse, Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow

C E R T I F I C A T I O N S

Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate • Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) • Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100) • Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900) • Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) • Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900) • Cloudera Certified Spark & Hadoop Developer (CCA175) • Oracle Certified Java SE 8 Programmer I (OCA) • MuleSoft Certified Integration & API Developer (MCD Associate)

P R O F E S S I O N A L E X P E R I E N C E

UBS · Associate Director – Data Engineering · Hyderabad

May 2025 – Present

Coforge · Technical Analyst · Hyderabad

Sep 2022 – May 2025

Mindtree · Module Lead · Bangalore

Jul 2020 – Aug 2022

Tech Mahindra · Senior Data Engineer · Bangalore

Apr 2019 – Jul 2020

Accenture · Software Engineer · Hyderabad

Apr 2015 – Apr 2019

P R O J E C T E X P E R I E N C E

Excalibur Data Framework – UBS — Associate Director – Data Engineering Tech: Spark (Scala/PySpark), Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, ADLS Gen2, PostgreSQL, GitLab CI/CD, Kubernetes (AKS), Apache Airflow

May 2025 – Present

Designed and developed scalable Spark-based ingestion frameworks to process high-volume market data into Delta Lake on Azure

Databricks.

Built curated ADLS-to-PostgreSQL publishing pipelines for downstream analytics and reporting applications. • Integrated Airflow for orchestration and scheduling of dependent Spark jobs with SLA monitoring, retry handling, and failure recovery. • Optimized distributed Spark pipelines via partitioning, caching, and join tuning for large-scale financial data workloads. • Implemented CI/CD pipelines using GitLab for automated build, testing, version control, and deployment of Spark and PySpark applications.

Emirates Airlines – Coforge — Technical Analyst Tech: Spark (Scala), PySpark, Azure Databricks, Snowflake, Cloudera CDP, Apache Oozie, Azure Data Factory (ADF)

Sep 2022 – May 2025

Developed enterprise data ingestion pipelines across raw, branded, LMO, and modelling layers using Spark (Scala) and Azure Databricks. • Designed and maintained Oozie workflows for orchestrating large-scale batch pipelines and downstream Snowflake integrations. • Built external tables and views in Snowflake to support business reporting and analytics use cases. • Developed API-based ingestion frameworks to extract, flatten, and process large-scale JSON data into curated Snowflake tables. • Contributed to migration of enterprise data pipelines from Cloudera CDP to Azure, replacing legacy Oozie workflows with Azure Data Factory.

BDL Harmonization – Unilever (via Mindtree) — Senior Azure Data Engineer Tech: Spark (Scala), PySpark, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory (ADF), ADLS Gen2, Azure DevOps, SBT

Dec 2020 – Aug 2022

Built scalable Azure-based data pipelines for ingesting and processing enterprise data using Spark, PySpark, and Azure Databricks. • Ingested data in multiple formats (Parquet, JSON, CSV) using Spark on Azure Databricks with Spark table registration in ADLS Gen2. • Developed orchestration pipelines in Azure Data Factory for full and incremental data loads. • Implemented complex Spark transformation logic applying optimization techniques including partitioning, caching, and broadcast joins. • Part of the architecture team for defining data structures; collaborated with client-side data engineering team on schema design. • Collaborated with Product Owners, Architects, and Business Analysts to design end-to-end enterprise data flows. • Implemented CI/CD pipelines via Azure DevOps for automated deployment and release management. Jul 2020 – Nov 2020

Built scalable Azure-based data pipelines for ingesting and processing enterprise data using Spark, PySpark, and Azure Databricks. • Ingested data in multiple formats (Parquet, JSON, CSV) using Spark on Azure Databricks with Spark table registration in ADLS Gen2. • Developed orchestration pipelines in Azure Data Factory for full and incremental data loads. • Implemented complex Spark transformation logic applying optimization techniques including partitioning, caching, and broadcast joins. • Part of the architecture team for defining data structures; collaborated with client-side data engineering team on schema design. • Collaborated with Product Owners, Architects, and Business Analysts to design end-to-end enterprise data flows. • Implemented CI/CD pipelines via Azure DevOps for automated deployment and release management. Jul 2020 – Nov 2020

Telecom Event Management – T-Mobile (via Tech Mahindra) — Senior Data Engineer Tech: Spark Structured Streaming, Scala, Apache Kafka, Elasticsearch, Kibana, SQL

Apr 2019 – Jul 2020

Developed real-time SNMP event management and Kafka-based streaming pipelines using Spark Structured Streaming, Scala, and

Elasticsearch.

Implemented DataStream joins, dynamic mapping refresh mechanisms, and stream transformation logic for large-scale network alarm

processing.

Reduced alarm processing traffic by 25% through threshold delay implementation, event deduplication, and reusable ingestion

framework development.

Anthem DataLake – Anthem Inc. (via Accenture) — Software Engineer Tech: HDFS, Apache Spark, Spark Streaming, Scala, Apache Kafka, Hive, HBase, Sqoop, StreamSets, Control-M

Apr 2015 – Apr 2019

Performed large-scale insurance data analysis and distributed processing using Hadoop, Apache Spark, Scala, and Kafka. • Developed enterprise data ingestion and Hive-to-HBase publishing frameworks processing data from Oracle, DB2, MySQL, JSON, CSV, TEXT, and EBCDIC sources.

Built automation and workflow scheduling frameworks using Spark, Scala, StreamSets, and Control-M for enterprise batch data

processing.
